description: WASHINGTON D.C., July 14, 2026 — Today, the U.S. House of Representatives passed H.R. 8770, the SAFEGUARDS Act of 2026, bipartisan legislation led by Representative Dale Strong to ensure passenger security fees are reinvested in aviation and airport security.Read the full release here.

title: Strong Delivers House Victory for Aviation Security
